dedupe_keys.name: hamburg public charging station utilization and location tables

description: This dataset supports analysis of where public charging stations are used in Hamburg. Lennart Adenaw and Sebastian Krapf at the Technical University of Munich combine Stromnetz Hamburg charging-station usage with OpenStreetMap location context. Published files include charging processes, charging-site geometries and connection-count profiles for all stations and four site clusters. Profile files separate weekdays, Saturdays, Sundays and weekends. Coverage is Hamburg, Germany; the repository does not establish the exact collection interval or a common temporal sampling resolution. CSV and GeoJSON files are publicly accessible free. The README explicitly retains the Hamburg source’s German attribution licence and the OpenStreetMap Open Database Licence. A limitation is that connection occupancy is not equivalent to metered electricity demand, and the source README does not supply a full column dictionary. The associated study analyses duration, daily transactions and connection ratios, which should be interpreted using its definitions. Simulation uses include calibrating charging occupancy patterns and evaluating candidate charging locations. It relates to data-openstreetmap for the spatial context. The data files were listed but not downloaded, and cluster assignments and utilization statistics were not reproduced.
